description: List a project's cloned voices (lab_voice_clone results) — id, label, voice house, sample and preview URLs. This is where a `voice_id` for lab_voice_tts or lab_dub comes from, and where you look up which house a voice belongs to before pricing it. Both houses are listed unless you narrow it. Reads only — no state changes, no credits.

project_id.description: Project id (from lab_list_projects) — positive integer as string

provider.description: Narrow the list to one voice house. Omit it and both come back, which is the normal case — a project can hold voices from either. An unknown value is refused rather than answered with an empty list: 'none found' and 'no such house' are different answers. What the houses can do: lab_list_models.

name: lab_list_voices
title: List Cloned Voices
